# SecondBrain

> SecondBrain is the AI second brain app for iPhone, Android and the web. You speak once and it remembers: it turns your voice into organized notes, calendar events and follow-ups, and gives your AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor) one shared long-term memory via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Free to download; the shared memory layer is a Pro feature. Private by design: no analytics, no ads, no training on your data.

## Key facts

- Category: AI memory and second brain app (productivity).
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS), Android, and web app at app.secondbrainmemory.com.
- Free to download and use; a Pro subscription unlocks the shared memory across AI assistants.
- Shared memory works with Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor via MCP.
- Deepest integration: a native Claude plugin (marketplace fed3c3sa/secondbrain-shared-memory).
- Setup takes about two minutes: sign in with Apple or Google, no API keys.
- Privacy: data stored in the EU (Supabase, Row-Level Security), never used to train models, deletable in one tap.
- App Store rating: 5.0 out of 5 (July 2026). Released April 2026.
- Maker: Federico Cesarini (github.com/fed3c3sa).
- Context on cross-assistant memory: ChatGPT and Claude cannot read each other's memory, and neither offers an import button. Copying by hand works once but goes stale; an MCP memory both connect to keeps them current. SecondBrain is a managed version of that memory.

## Guides

- [How to share one memory between ChatGPT and Claude](https://secondbrainmemory.com/chatgpt-claude-shared-memory/): Why assistants cannot share memory natively and how to connect them to one shared memory over MCP in about two minutes.
- [How to transfer ChatGPT memory to Claude](https://secondbrainmemory.com/transfer-chatgpt-memory-to-claude/): There is no import button. The manual move that works today, what actually transfers, and how to keep both assistants current afterwards.
- [What is an MCP memory server?](https://secondbrainmemory.com/mcp-memory-server/): A plain-English guide to MCP memory servers, with the main managed and self-hosted options in 2026 compared.

- [Memoria permanente per ChatGPT e Claude (in italiano)](https://secondbrainmemory.com/it/memoria-ai/): La guida italiana alla memoria AI condivisa via MCP.

## Connect to an AI assistant

- Claude: add the marketplace `fed3c3sa/secondbrain-shared-memory`, install the SecondBrain plugin, then Connect and sign in with Apple or Google.
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add fed3c3sa/secondbrain-shared-memory`, then `/plugin install secondbrain@secondbrain`, then `/mcp` and sign in.
- ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor: run `npx secondbrain-connect` once and sign in in the browser.
- Note: the shared memory is a Pro feature; enable it in the app first.
